CASE-DELETE.note: New user-requested feature outside the R-queue. Backend gates: exclusive case.lock must be free (case open in another instance is refused), typed case-name confirmation must match on-disk meta name, folder must contain case.sqlite3 with user_version<=6 and a meta id/name. Deleting the open case stops on running tasks/jobs and active imports, closes the case first, then removes the whole folder and returns a bytes/sources/records receipt. Frontend: case menu Delete case… (disabled without an open native case) and command-palette entry open a dialog warning that originals/working files/chats/review history/archives inside the case folder are erased irreversibly; the destructive button enables only when the typed name matches; on success the projects list, last-case pointer and conversation pointer are cleared and the app returns to onboarding. Exports/archives the user saved outside the case folder are intentionally untouched. Deletion runs while holding the app case mutex by design: renderer stays responsive (spawn_blocking), other case commands queue honestly behind the removal. Known non-goal: a backup/export streaming concurrently from another trigger has no tracked in-flight state and would fail with an IO error rather than corrupt other data.
